descriptionNullable:
# 🍿 Netflix User Watching Behavior Dataset

This dataset simulates realistic user behavior on a streaming platform similar to Netflix.  
It captures how users interact with streaming content, their binge-watching habits, engagement levels, and subscription characteristics.

The dataset is designed for machine learning, recommender systems, churn prediction, and behavioral analytics projects.

---

# 🎯 Possible Use Cases

• User behavior analysis  
• Streaming engagement prediction  
• Customer churn prediction  
• Recommendation system development  
• Clustering and segmentation of viewers  
• Feature engineering practice for ML models

---

# 📊 Dataset Characteristics

- 50,000 users
- 20 behavioral and demographic features
- Realistic synthetic streaming behavior
- Suitable for supervised and unsupervised learning

---

# 📁 Files

`netflix_user_behavior_dataset.csv`

---

# 🧾 Column Descriptions

| Column | Description |
|------|------|
| user_id | Unique identifier for each user |
| age | Age of the user |
| gender | Gender of the user |
| country | Country where the user resides |
| account_age_months | Number of months the account has been active |
| subscription_type | Netflix subscription plan (Basic / Standard / Premium) |
| monthly_fee | Monthly subscription cost |
| payment_method | Payment method used for subscription |
| primary_device | Main device used for streaming |
| devices_used | Number of devices used to access the account |
| favorite_genre | User's most watched genre |
| avg_watch_time_minutes | Average minutes watched per day |
| watch_sessions_per_week | Number of viewing sessions per week |
| binge_watch_sessions | Number of binge watching sessions per month |
| completion_rate | Percentage of content watched fully |
| rating_given | Average rating given by the user |
| content_interactions | Number of likes, reviews, or interactions |
| recommendation_click_rate | Percentage of recommendations clicked |
| days_since_last_login | Days since the user last used the platform |
| churned | Whether the user stopped using the platform |

---

# 📌 Sources

This dataset is **synthetically generated** to mimic realistic streaming platform user behavior.  
It does not contain real user data and is intended for **educational and research purposes**.

---

# ⚠️ Disclaimer

This dataset is not affiliated with or sourced from Netflix.  
It is a simulated dataset created for machine learning and data science experimentation.
